body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2011') -- <Visual News> Samsung(www.samsung.com) unveild '700Z', slide type notebook which can be changed into Tablet PC for the first time at the International Consumer Electronics Show(CES) held at Las Vegas, USA, for 4 days from January 6.
'700Z' is laptop with Window platform 10.1-inch display and supporting Intel Oak Trail Z670 processor.
<AVING Special Report Team for 2011 International CES: Ideak Kim, Kevin Choi, Joseph Choi, Paul Shin, Jun Lim, Daniel Kim, Ashley Kim, Sohpia Kwag, Mia Eun, Sena Moon, Jiny Kim, Astin Jung>
